page_title: NAP 2-1 FIO | Napoli v Fiorentina 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+1' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' It will be a substitution. Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is ready to enter the pitch as Rasmus Hojlund walks off.
90' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
87' Great touch by Scott McTominay (Napoli) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
84' Antonio Conte is forced to make a change. Antonio Vergara is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Giovane (Napoli).
83' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

83' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
81' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) tackles a bit over-zealously and Federico La Penna blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Fiorentina.
79' Substitution. Albert Gudmundsson leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina).
77' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

76' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Alex Meret shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Fiorentina get a corner.
76' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Fiorentina.
74' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 17:9.
71' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Manor Solomon and he is replaced by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina).
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) for Robin Gosens.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marco Brescianini trots off the pitch and is replaced by Moise Kean (Fiorentina).
70' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
67' David de Gea comes off his line to intercept the corner from Eljif Elmas (Napoli).
65' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. There is a free kick near the sideline to Napoli.
64' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes.
60' David de Gea was forced into action to thwart Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper.
60' Napoli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
57' 2 - 1 Goal! Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 2:1.
57' Great teamplay by Fiorentina as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
54' The foul by Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Federico La Penna.

49' 2 - 0 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the left side of the net.
46' Paolo Vanoli makes a half-time substitution. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) comes on in place of Giovanni Fabbian.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.

45+1' Eljif Elmas finds Scott McTominay (Napoli) after some good work, but from the edge of the box he skews his attempted shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Federico La Penna shows the yellow card to Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) for a heavy challenge.
44' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick.

41' Chance! Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Scott McTominay, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
39' Chance! Scott McTominay (Napoli) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but David de Gea is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
39' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
38' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Antonio Vergara (Napoli) but poses no threat.
34' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) is penalised for holding. Federico La Penna signals a set piece. Napoli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
33' Corner kick. Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) is ready to send the ball into the box.
32' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. Fiorentina will take a corner kick.
32' The resulting set piece from Fiorentina is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
31' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
30' Problems for Antonio Conte as Giovanni Di Lorenzo is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Mathias Olivera (Napoli) replaces him.
27' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

26' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Alex Meret, who pulls off a stunning save! Fiorentina win a corner.

25' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He plants a header against the right post and it bounces away off it.
23' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but David de Gea makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
20' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Antonio Vergara (Napoli) takes it short.

20' Antonio Vergara (Napoli) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.
19' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.

17' Leonardo Spinazzola sends a lofted pass into the box, Scott McTominay (Napoli) shows good awareness to connect with it but drags his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
15' The Napoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
11' 1 - 0 Antonio Vergara (Napoli) picks up a brilliant lofted pass just outside the penalty area and smashes the ball into the bottom right corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
9' Wasted opportunity. Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
9' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) takes a short corner kick.
8' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Antonio Vergara (Napoli) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Napoli have a corner.
7' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) tries to play a long through ball into Rasmus Hojlund, but the defence breaks the move down. The ball has crossed the sideline. Napoli are taking a throw-in.
5' Juan Jesus (Napoli) plays a long ball to Eljif Elmas, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear. The linesman signals a throw-in for Napoli.
3' A raking crossfield pass from Antonio Vergara (Napoli) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
2' Federico La Penna interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Scott McTominay (Napoli). Fiorentina get a free kick.
1' The first half has started.
Napoli will kick the game off.
Federico La Penna will supervise the game today.
